title: Paid Media Karachi: Google, Meta, TikTok Ads | 22 Signals
description: Paid media Karachi brands and B2B firms can trace to orders: Google, Meta, LinkedIn and TikTok ads with in-house creative and WhatsApp lead tracking.
h1: Paid media Karachi brands can trace from ad to order
intro: We plan, create and run paid media for Karachi companies across Google Search, Performance Max, YouTube, Meta, LinkedIn and TikTok. Creative is made in-house, landing pages are built for mobile, and every WhatsApp chat, call and order is tracked back to the campaign. It suits retail and fashion brands, clinics, developers, fintechs and B2B firms.

sections.h: Spending on ads without knowing what works
p: Plenty of Karachi businesses spend real money on boosted Instagram posts and Google Ads every month and still cannot say which campaign produced which customer. The ad sends people to WhatsApp, the chat happens on a staff phone, the order is confirmed by call and paid on delivery. By the time the sale is booked, the link to the ad is gone.

That makes every budget conversation a guess. The fix is not more spend. It is campaigns built around measurement, so you can move money from what does not work to what does. For a Karachi retailer that might mean learning that TikTok brings first-time buyers while Google brings repeat ones, and budgeting for both on purpose rather than by habit.

sections.h: The Karachi calendar shapes the plan
p: Retail demand in the city moves with the calendar. Ramadan changes when people browse, with activity shifting late into the night after iftar and around sehri. The weeks before Eid are the peak for fashion, footwear, gifts and food. Lawn and summer collections launch in spring, wedding season drives jewellery, formalwear and venues in the cooler months, and year-end sales compete for the same attention.
We plan budgets, creative and bidding around those moments, and book creative production early so the ads are ready before the competition fills the feed.

list: Fashion, beauty and e-commerce: Meta and TikTok for discovery, Google Shopping and Performance Max for intent, with cash-on-delivery confirmations tracked.
Clinics and healthcare in Clifton, DHA and beyond: Google Search and click-to-WhatsApp, within Meta and Google health advertising rules.
Real estate developers: YouTube and Meta for project launches, lead forms with fast follow-up, and campaigns aimed at overseas Pakistanis.
Banks, fintechs and insurers: Google, Meta and LinkedIn for products, with copy cleared by your compliance team.
Logistics, freight and B2B services: Google Search and LinkedIn aimed at importers, exporters and procurement heads.
FMCG brands: YouTube, Meta and TikTok for awareness, with retailer and distributor campaigns where relevant.

p: Paid social needs a steady supply of fresh creative. We run a managed video editing team for a US client, producing edits week after week to a set standard. The same production setup feeds our ad accounts, so Karachi campaigns are not stuck running one tired video for three months.

sections.h: How it works: Talk, Plan, Build, Grow
p: Talk: your margins, best customers, delivery areas across Karachi and what a lead or order is worth to you.
Plan: channels, audiences, areas, budgets by month, creative briefs and a tracking plan, all written down.

Build: tracking first, then landing pages, creative and campaigns. Nothing launches until we can measure it, including the cash-on-delivery orders that are confirmed by phone or WhatsApp after the click.
Grow: weekly optimisation, monthly reports and regular creative refreshes, with budget moved toward what performs.

Financial, health and property ads face extra platform rules, and regulated firms need their own sign-off. We build compliance review into the creative schedule rather than treating it as a last step. For tracking we use consent-aware setups, server-side conversion APIs where useful, and only the customer data needed to measure results, in line with PECA 2016 and the principles of Pakistan's draft Personal Data Protection Bill.

sections.h: How campaigns are run and checked
p: Your campaigns are run by one Signal Lead with specialists behind them. Account ownership is agreed in writing before launch, and you keep full access. We check performance daily, pause what is wasting money and send a written report each month on leads, cost per lead and sales. Shoots that need to happen in the city are briefed by us and planned into the scope.

list: Creative volume: how many videos, statics and variations each month.
Tracking complexity, especially WhatsApp and cash-on-delivery attribution.
Your media budget, which is paid to the platforms separately from our fee.

p: The paid media Karachi companies usually buy splits strategy, creative and tracking across three suppliers. We keep them together: ads, video, 3D, landing pages, WhatsApp automation and SEO in one team under one lead. That is how we stay accountable for results instead of clicks. faqs.q: Which ad platforms work best in Karachi?
faqs.a: It depends on what you sell. Consumer brands usually get the most from Meta and TikTok for discovery and Google for intent. B2B firms do better with Google Search and LinkedIn. Real estate and launches use YouTube heavily. We recommend a mix in the plan and adjust it based on tracked results.

faqs.q: Can you track WhatsApp leads from ads?
faqs.a: Yes. We use click-to-WhatsApp campaigns with tagged entry points, connect the WhatsApp Business API to your CRM where possible, and record which campaign started each chat. For cash-on-delivery orders we match confirmed and delivered orders back to the ad, so you see real sales, not just conversations.

faqs.q: Do you make the ad creative?
faqs.a: Yes, in-house. We produce short-form video, motion graphics, static designs and 3D product visuals sized for each platform, in Urdu, English or both. Fresh creative is planned monthly so performance does not drop from ad fatigue. If you have a brand team, we work from your guidelines.

faqs.q: What budget do we need for paid media Karachi campaigns?
faqs.a: There is no fixed minimum, but the budget must be large enough for the platforms to learn and for results to be measurable. We look at your margins, order values and goals, then propose a media budget by channel. The media spend goes to Google, Meta, LinkedIn or TikTok directly, separately from our fee.

faqs.q: What do you need from us before launch?
faqs.a: Admin access to your ad accounts, or permission to create them in your name, plus your website analytics and a way to see which leads became sales, even if that is a simple spreadsheet. We also need product details, current offers and any approvals your brand requires. With those in place, the first campaigns go live once the written plan is signed off.

faqs.q: Can you run ads for financial products?
faqs.a: Yes, with care. Google and Meta have specific rules for financial services ads, and your copy will often need sign-off from your compliance team under SBP or SECP rules. We build that review into the schedule and keep claims accurate, so campaigns are not rejected or paused.
